title: Vegan Ukrainian Borscht
description: A classic Ukrainian beet soup adapted to be vegan, with a depth of flavor from garlic and a hint of smokiness.

ingredients.name: fry
ingredients.notes: fry onions and carrots until crispy, but not burnt.

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add the grated carrots and continue to sauté for another 5 minutes.
Add the beets, canned tomatoes, and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the beets are tender.
Stir in the borscht, apple cider vinegar, and crispy fry onions and carrots.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill or parsley, if desired.
Note: You can make this recipe in a slow cooker. Simply brown the garlic and onion in a pan, then transfer everything to the slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours.
Note: You can also add other vegetables to the soup, such as diced bell peppers or chopped cabbage.
Note: If you want a creamier soup, you can add a splash of non-dairy milk or a dollop of vegan sour cream.
